answer: Each agent identity is registered in the inlet contract only after a zero-knowledge SGX/TPM attestation binds its key to measured code and a hardware clock-drift bound. The comet state tree anchors attestations, while lagoon consensus verifies proofs and applies an O(N^2) bonding curve. Forging identities requires compromising distinct physical enclaves and replay-resistant clocks; failed proofs irreversibly slash collateral.
